verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review and Graphite Chat features are explicitly documented as operating on pull requests after they are pushed ('analyze every pull request', 'catching bugs in your pull requests', 'review page'), not inside the IDE before push. The only IDE-related mention (docs-14) refers to a GUI for visualizing stacks, not for catching review issues pre-push, so there is no evidence of an in-editor pre-push review capability.
